2609.21151.title: EnSol: an environment-aware graph neural network for molecular solubility prediction
2609.21151.paper_summary: Molecular solubility directly affects key aspects of molecular development such as reaction feasibility, formulation performance, separation efficiency, and solvent selection. However, experimental measurement across solutes, solvents, and temperatures remains costly and sparsely sampled. Existing computational models often rely on fixed-solvent assumptions, deterministic formulations, or simplified representations of solute-solvent interactions, limiting their ability to capture complex molecular interactions, continuous temperature effects, and experimental uncertainty. Here, we introduce EnSol, an environment-aware probabilistic framework for molecular solubility prediction. EnSol represents the solute and solvent as molecular graphs and learns separate representations for each before bringing them together through cross-attention to capture solute-solvent interactions. Temperature is incorporated directly into the solvent environment through feature-wise modulation, and a mixture density network predicts full solubility distributions to capture both temperature-dependent behavior and experimental uncertainty. On the independent SolProp and Leeds benchmark datasets, EnSol achieved Spearman correlations of 0.876 and 0.601, respectively, outperforming state-of-the-art solubility prediction models across both benchmarks. Beyond computational benchmarking, experimental validation across chemically diverse solute-solvent pairs showed that EnSol maintained strong predictive performance and supported reliable solvent ranking, achieving a Spearman correlation of 0.715. These results show that EnSol can support reliable solubility prediction and solvent selection across diverse chemical systems while accounting for predictive uncertainty.
2609.21151.paper_summary_zh: 分子溶解度直接影響分子發展的關鍵方面，如反應可行性、配方性能、分離效率和溶劑選擇。<lb/>然而，對於溶質、溶劑和溫度的實驗測量仍然成本高昂且樣本稀疏。<lb/>現有的計算模型通常依賴於固定溶劑假設、確定性配方或簡化的溶質-溶劑相互作用表示，限制了它們捕捉複雜分子相互作用、連續溫度效應和實驗不確定性的能力。<lb/>在此，我們介紹了 EnSol，一個環境感知的概率框架，用於分子溶解度預測。<lb/>EnSol 將溶質和溶劑表示為分子圖，並為每個圖學習單獨的表示，然後通過交叉注意力將它們結合在一起，以捕捉溶質-溶劑相互作用。<lb/>溫度通過特徵調制直接納入溶劑環境中，混合密度網絡預測完整的溶解度分佈，以捕捉溫度依賴的行為和實驗不確定性。<lb/>在獨立的 SolProp 和 Leeds 基準數據集上，EnSol 分別達到了 0.876 和 0.601 的斯皮爾曼相關性，超越了兩個基準的最先進溶解度預測模型。<lb/>除了計算基準外，對化學多樣的溶質-溶劑對進行的實驗驗證顯示，EnSol 維持了強大的預測性能並支持可靠的溶劑排名，達到了 0.715 的斯皮爾曼相關性。<lb/>這些結果表明，EnSol 能夠在考慮預測不確定性的情況下，支持多樣化化學系統中的可靠溶解度預測和溶劑選擇。
